CA.rationale: Candidate content entries are paired with attached origin/process metadata (command_estimate) tying processing condition to the same content/time.

COD.rationale: Current red content is explicitly identified (coordinates), its organization/presentation is given as coordinate listing, and an origin/status field differentiates its source/status.

A.rationale: Origin/process tags (history_estimate, command_estimate) are attached to specific content entries, linking processing/estimation conditions to those contents.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored contents (red/blue) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin metadata separately attributes source/status (copied_prior_record, command_estimate) to the identified contents, distinguishing identity from status/access.

O.rationale: Contents are presented as organized coordinate sets (full-grid listings), indicating representation/organization for current and candidate times.
